name: Guardian Sphinx
extDescription: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. When this card is Flip Summoned, return all monsters on your opponent''s side of the field to the owner''s hand.

name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Increase the ATK of this card by 300 points for each Spell Counter on this card. By removing 1 Spell Counter from this card, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Exodia Necross
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of Contract with Exodia.  This card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effects of Spell or Trap Cards, and during each of your Standby Phases, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.  This card is destroyed when any of Exodia the Forbidden One, Right Arm of the Forbidden One, Left Arm of the Forbidden One, Right Leg of the Forbidden One, or Left Leg of the Forbidden One is not in your Graveyard.

name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
cleanName: Black Luster Soldier Envoy of the Beginning
extDescription:
This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard from play. Once during each of your turns, you can select and activate 1 of the following effects:
-Remove 1 monster on the field from play. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
-If this card destroyed your opponent''s monster as a result of battle, it can attack once again in a row.

name: Blowback Dragon
extDescription: Toss a coin 3 times. If at least 2 of the results are Heads, select 1 card on your opponent''s side of the field and destroy it. This effect can only be used once per turn during your Main Phase.

name: Theinen the Great Sphinx
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set.  This card cannot be Special Summoned except by paying 500 Life Points when both Andro Sphinx and Spinx Teleia on your side of the field are destroyed at the same time; then you can Special Summon this monster from your hand or Deck.  When this card is Special Summoned, by paying 500 Life Points, increase the ATK of this card by 3000 points until the end of th End Phase.

name: Master Collection Volume 2 Binder
extDescription:
Each Binder contains 6 secret rare MC2-EN### versions of Guardian Sphinx, Breaker the Magical Warrior, Exodia Necross, Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning, Blowback Dragon, and Theinen the Great Sphinx.

It also contains one of each of the following unlimited printed booster packs:
• Pharaonic Guardian
• Magician's Force
• Dark Crisis
• Invasion of Crisis
• Ancient Sanctuary
• Exclusive Pack
